mentions.name: asterbot
mentions.description: This project is a modular AI agent built around a microkernel-style architecture, where every capability—tools, memory, LLM providers, etc.—is a swappable WASM component. Components can be written in any language (Rust, Go, Python, JS), run sandboxed via WASI, and are pulled from the open asterai registry.
